text:
Maya (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing segment. Capturing Qs and action items here.

Owen (Finance): quick summary: we enforce per-route and per-org rate windows. Paid tiers get a short grace-burst (standard: 15s, enterprise: 30s). After the grace window, excess requests hit 429 or are soft-throttled depending on policy.

Sofia (Billing): credits expiry: promotional credits 12 months, trial credits 90 days. Enterprise contracts can have custom expiration terms. We also have an optional auto-topup flag that orgs can enable to auto-purchase when balance < threshold.

Ben (Support): on 429 responses we include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Window`, and `Retry-After`. We're piloting `X-Credit-Balance` for opt-in customers. Response body example: `{'error':'rate_limited','retry_after_seconds':60}`.

rachel_k (eng): implementation detail: for Dedicated customers we try model-variant fallback (e.g., lower-precision quantized model) before returning 429 if the customer's routing policy allows it. Fallbacks are site-configurable per-customer.

Maya (Product): question: can customers request temporary capacity for launches/demos?

Owen (Finance): yes. We offer demo passes: standard plans can get 48-hour 2x baseline auto-approve; partners get 72-hour 3x baseline; above that requires Sales approval. Request via Support with expected TPS + token/sec.

Sofia (Billing): programmatic checks: use `GET /v1/account/credits` (lightly rate-limited) and `GET /v1/usage/summary` for per-route breakdown. Example return: `{"balance":"8000","expires_at":"2027-04-01T00:00:00Z"}`.

Ben (Support): refunds/adjustments: we audit and can issue credit adjustments case-by-case if consumption was due to platform fault or misconfig. Typical turn-around 3-7 business days; include request ids + timestamps in ticket.

Ava (CEO): strategic note: no planned pricing changes next quarter. We'll publish a model-family pricing guidance and quantization discount examples in the product update next month.

Maya (Product): follow-ups: I'll draft an FAQ, sample backoff code, and customer-facing doc for demo passes. Will post by EOD and link here.

DeployBot: slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/mar-22-pricing

Owen (Finance): note: orgs with both Hosted and Dedicated under same account get Dedicated billed first; hosted credits only used for fallthrough if cross-fallback enabled. We're working on an "effective credit burn" metric to show combined impact.

rachel_k (eng): ops improvement idea: include `Retry-After-Type` header (e.g., "burst" vs "quota") and `X-Quota-Window` to help clients distinguish. I'll add this to the backlog.

Ben (Support): I'll collate customer-friendly wording and examples; tagging @Maya for review.

Maya (Product): thanks team. If anyone needs EA access to quota shadow mode, DM me and I'll add you to the list. :thumbsup:
